facts.business: Glaam Up Jwel Limited (formerly Gleam Fabmat Limited) is engaged in the sale of products, recognizing revenue on dispatch from warehouse to customers, and earns other income from interest on bank deposits, dividend income, and profit/loss on sale of mutual funds.

auditor.name: Not stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (1) Non-provision of interest on outstanding credit facility of Rs. 2.06 crore from Axis Bank Limited since December 31, 2019, with matter pending before DRT-III, Delhi; (2) Non-provision for penalty of INR 2,223.54 lakh imposed by CGST authorities alleging fraudulent ITC availment, which may cast significant doubt on going concern if liability materializes.

key_risks: Default on credit facility of Rs. 2.06 crore from Axis Bank Limited since December 31, 2019, with restraint on mortgaged property (commercial shop owned by Director Mrs. Puspha Gupta) per DRT order dated December 21, 2020

Penalty of INR 2,223.54 lakh imposed by Joint Commissioner, CGST Delhi North vide order dated December 26, 2026, alleging fraudulent availment and passing on of Input Tax Credit, with no provision recognized and disclosed as contingent liability
Auditor's qualified opinion stating the CGST penalty matter may cast significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as a going concern if liability materializes
facts.related_party_note: Mortgaged property for Axis Bank credit facility is a commercial shop owned by Mrs. Puspha Gupta, Director of the Company.
